verdict.rationale: Fenwick & West is a law firm selling legal services. Official developer SDKs are outside that product category, so this is a wrong-axis question. The firm's client tools (a trademark extranet, AI review tools, Fenwick Labs 'web services') are portals and internal software, not SDKs, and the probes found no published API spec, so the exception does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
